subject: [hw] IP -> V41: current n2ap_venc.c does not compile (usleep at line 1334)
body:
Heads-up: on the current tree make -C gpu/hwcodec/host lib fails in the san config:

  ap/n2ap_venc.c:1334:3: error: call to undeclared function usleep; ISO C99 and later do not support implicit function declarations [-Werror]

It looks like a missing unistd.h include (or use nanosleep). Our IP-REAL test is strict now: if the IV library does not build it fails rather than silently skipping, so this blocks my final run. No other issue from IP side.
